94a01b98c5733d7687ded09bd38dd6bce6048149.title_en: Public Comment: Draft Cabinet Order Amending Rules on National Public Servants' Mutual Aid Association Long-Term...
94a01b98c5733d7687ded09bd38dd6bce6048149.summary_en: This is a public comment (opinion solicitation) on a draft Cabinet Order that would amend an order relating to the National Public Servants' Mutual Aid Association Act, including transitional measures for long-term benefits connected to earlier reforms of pension and retirement-benefit legislation. According to the metadata, the draft was published on 2026-08-20 with a comment deadline of 2026-09-19, and the responsible body is the Salary and Mutual Aid Division of the Budget Bureau, Ministry of Finance.
